name: comp-309
title: Feature Launch Banner
blurb: Dark feature launch banner with rocket icon, title, description, and try now…
description: Full-width dark-themed feature launch with rocket icon in colored circle background, title, description text, Try now button, and dismissible close.
use_when: You need a prominent feature launch with rich content (title + description) and clear call-to-action.
avoid_when: For simple announcements; use simpler banners instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icon wrapper marked aria-hidden. Component uses useState to manage visibility.
